history.name: A front page that summarises the product
history.description: The edition opens on its own page with the client's masthead, the version and its date, a short statement of what the product is, and a panel summarising the whole record: how many features across how many areas, and a proportional bar showing the split between standalone capabilities, meaningful pieces and specific touches — with the key spelling out what each of those means. Somebody who reads only the first page still comes away with the shape of what they have.
history.dev_notes: The .front header block in LedgerHtml#render(); sizeShare() computes the bar to two decimals so the segments fill it exactly.
